items.definition:
a long walk for pleasure; or, discourse that is lengthy and confused
We went for a pleasant rambling walk through the woods.

the action of restoring a stock or supply to a former level
The store ordered a large replenishment of its most popular items.

a rose-shaped ornament, marking, or badge
She wore a small silk rosette pinned to her lapel.

the shares held by an individual or group in a company
His significant shareholding in the company gave him a strong voice in major decisions.

a thin strip of material used for packing, leveling, or adjusting
He used a small wooden shim to level the wobbly table leg.

a tall, pointed structure on top of a church tower
The church steeple was visible from miles away.

a member of a people inhabiting Tajikistan and neighboring areas of Central Asia; the language of this people
He is a Tajik from Dushanbe.

the time allowed for or taken by a process or sequence of events
The project has a very tight timescale.

a silly or foolish person
Don't be such a twit, that's a silly idea.

a sudden and complete defeat or destruction; a fall from a surfboard
The company suffered a complete wipeout in the last quarter.

a citadel or fortified part of an ancient Greek city, typically built on a hill
The Parthenon stands proudly on the Athenian Acropolis.

the process of adapting or being adapted
The company's quick adaption to new technologies ensured its survival.

a place where weapons are kept
The museum displayed ancient weapons in its armoury.

the players in a team who play behind the forward line
The quarterback handed the ball off to the running back in the backfield.

Bachelor of Business Administration
She is studying for her BBA at the local university.

a salt of carbonic acid
Bicarbonate of soda is often used in baking.

a large naturally occurring community of flora and fauna occupying a major habitat
The rainforest is a rich and diverse biome.

a main branch of a tree
A bird was perched on a thick bough of the oak tree.

Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (Mad Cow Disease)
Concerns about BSE led to a ban on certain beef imports.

a device for a guitar; a mafia boss
He put a capo on the guitar to change the key.

a shared feature or characteristic
Despite their differences, they found a commonality in their love for music.

unproductive or useless people or things
The company decided to cut the deadwood from its workforce to improve efficiency.

the rate at which something slows down
The car's rapid deceleration caused the passengers to lurch forward.

a slight hollow in a surface made by a blow or pressure
There was a small dint in the car door after it was hit by a shopping cart.

an area where ships are built or repaired
The old dockyard is being redeveloped into a modern residential and commercial area.

a coarse woolen cloth or a bag made from it
He packed his clothes into a large duffel bag for the weekend trip.

a master of ceremonies
The comedian was the emcee for the awards show, keeping the audience entertained.

a person (informal) or one who fells trees
He's a good feller, always willing to lend a hand when you need it.

flat land next to a river, prone to flooding
The town was built on a floodplain, making it vulnerable to seasonal floods.

a person or organization that provides financial support
The project is seeking a new funder to continue its research.

a fragrant flowering plant
The garden was filled with the sweet scent of hyacinths.

a person who imitates the voice or mannerisms of others
The Elvis impersonator entertained the crowd.

a type of thorny shrub or small tree native to arid regions of the Americas
Mesquite wood is often used for barbecuing.

the act of assembling and making ready for use or action
The country began a general mobilisation of its forces.

Mass Rapid Transit (a subway or metro system)
Take the MRT to get to the city center quickly.

Islamic religious leader
The mullah delivered a sermon at the mosque.

the act of making something as effective as possible
The team focused on the optimisation of their workflow.

waxy substance; kerosene (UK)
The candle was made of paraffin wax.

an odd or unusual feature
One of his peculiarities was his habit of talking to himself.

an animal that carries pollen
Bees are important pollinators for many plants.

an attempt to make something appear true
He made a pretence of being busy.

the quality of being on time
Punctuality is important for professional meetings.

a disease caused by a deficiency of vitamin C
Sailors on long voyages were often afflicted with scurvy.

a short dagger with a tapering blade; a high, slender heel on a woman's shoe
She wore elegant black stilettos to the party.

a prefix meaning 10^12 (one trillion)
A terabyte (TB) is a unit of digital information equal to one trillion bytes.

a loose flowing outer garment worn by citizens of ancient Rome
Roman senators wore a toga as a symbol of their status.

a quavering or vibratory sound, especially a rapid alternation between two musical notes
The bird's song ended with a beautiful trill.

a telecommunication link from an earth station to a satellite or aircraft
The satellite established an uplink with the ground station.

vaccine or vaccination (informal)
Have you had your flu vax yet?

a person who worships God or a god
The worshipers gathered in the temple for the ceremony.

a person who achieves success
She is a high achiever in her academic studies.

a person who has had a limb amputated
The athlete, an amputee, competed in the Paralympics.

the defensive players in a team sport; the rhythm section of a band
The coach strengthened the team's backline.

a large muscle in the upper arm
He flexed his bicep to show off his strength.

the repurchase of something previously sold, especially shares by a company
The company announced a share buyback program to boost investor confidence.

a national organization responsible for protecting the coast and rescuing people at sea
The coastguard rescued the stranded sailors.

the action or process of settling among and establishing control over the indigenous people of an area
The colonisation of new territories had a profound impact on global history.

a sudden, violent, irregular movement of a limb or of the body, caused by involuntary contraction of muscles
The patient suffered a convulsion during the seizure.

a heavy iron bar with a flattened end, used as a lever
He used a crowbar to pry open the wooden crate.

outward behavior or bearing
His calm demeanour reassured everyone during the crisis.

a substance that reduces physiological or nervous activity
Alcohol acts as a depressant on the central nervous system.

the act of withdrawing or detaching
The disengagement of troops from the conflict zone was a positive step.

a window that projects vertically from a sloping roof
The house had a charming dormer window on the second floor.

an imagined state or society where there is great suffering or injustice
Many science fiction novels explore themes of dystopia.
